dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: Ah, so you don't know who lives here?

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: That's funny. If you don't know who owns this place, then who are you here to see?

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: I can't be of help if you don't know who you're looking for. Now, if you'll excuse my lack of decorum.
